name: mesh-room
description: Peer-to-peer video rooms for up to 6 people, built on hand-written WebRTC

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
